CI installs an exact, checksum-verified Firefox Developer Edition build >=154 recorded in browser-pin.json
The repository harness installs the packaged XPI once and can open/close extension pages, force event-page idle unload via test-profile prefs, and restart the profile, without Firefox DevTools MCP

The accepted P026 product passes baseline packaged checks under the new pin, and every ADR-002/ADR-003 platform fact marked (verify) is recorded as pinned-build evidence; the ESR-153 decision is recorded

Exactly one PCMS Core exists per extension background context; dashboard/popup code constructs no Core service; PersonaMonkey fail-closed bootstrap ordering is preserved; in-process broker endpoint is Integration-v1-parity

Cold-start recovery is unchanged from P026; a warm wake turns interrupted DISPATCHING into UNCERTAIN + RECOVERY_HOLD and never replays; assisted provider steps persist as HumanTasks reconcilable from any tab or after all tabs close

UI requests are sender- and schema-validated, commands idempotent, projections refreshed by the storage.session revision signal; opening/closing any number of PCMS tabs never starts, stops or recovers Core
The durable Core timer service is the only timer authority; alarms are recreated from durable timers on cold start; duplicate and spurious wakes are harmless
Missed or interrupted work yields at most one catch-up per declared schedule; no backlog replay; an unload at any step boundary recovers deterministically
In the packaged XPI under the pinned FDE, a Core-scheduled job runs with zero PCMS tabs open, across forced event-page unloads and a profile restart

The production manifest declares the controller and module-UI sandbox pages with CSPs granting no network, no allow-same-origin and no extension APIs; unsupported Firefox versions report the module runtime UNAVAILABLE
Controller source supplied at runtime (not in the XPI) executes in a background-hosted sandbox frame of the packaged XPI; browser/chrome are absent; ungranted capabilities are denied
Frames are created per generation and disposed on fence or unload; P004 bootstrap/RPC bounds are preserved
A fixture module package not compiled into the XPI is installed through PCMS and its controller starts and executes in the packaged XPI, with no rebuild, reinstall, reload or Firefox restart
The module can use only approved capabilities; its declared scheduled work runs with zero PCMS tabs, survives event-page unload and profile restart with bounded catch-up
Update activates a new generation without reload and the previous generation can no longer write, call services or dispatch; disable/enable/rollback/remove work live
Routes are canonical and fail closed; legacy links resolve; no dashboard code constructs Core services
Receipts and HumanTasks are durable and consistent across two tabs and persist after all tabs close; there is no global 'Working' state
The shell shows Core running/idle/unavailable correctly and refreshes from the revision signal, never from UI timers driving operations
A fixture built-in module and a fixture runtime module appear in navigation, Overview, search and facets without Core edits beyond the bundled-module list
A runtime module page runs in the sandboxed module-UI frame without extension APIs or network; risky actions are confirmed by Core-rendered dialogs
Disabled, updating, failed, incompatible and removed modules degrade gracefully; dashboards keep working while modules are unloaded
No Accounts workflow requires typing an Account ID or personaUid
Persona rebind is refused with a visible reason while unresolved operations exist for the account
A 52-account fixture is navigable with paging, filtering, sorting and deep links
The popup body keeps a fixed 370px intrinsic width; the ESR regression test covers the new block
The status summary contains no secret, cookieStoreId or HumanTask instruction text
The popup reports Core running/idle/unavailable and opens the correct PCMS deep link
Deployer v1 records migrate losslessly and existing RemoteOperations remain linked
The generator status derivation table passes exhaustively; isPrivate appears only inside the Perchance adapter with UNKNOWN fallback
Manual deployment needs no typed IDs, runs as a background command with a durable assisted handoff, and never replays UNCERTAIN
The same commit yields identical snapshots and payload hashes across runs and time zones; no GitHub response object crosses the provider boundary
Changed releases become update-ready, unchanged ones are untouched, and a modified published release is blocked
Scans execute as bounded background steps; failures keep the previous snapshot and never mark generators removed
Repository checks run on cadence with zero PCMS tabs; after sleep or restart exactly one catch-up check runs
At most one pending scan schedule exists; duplicate wakes are harmless; backoff honours rate-limit resets; failed scans never remove desired state
An event-page unload during any scan step recovers deterministically without duplicate deployment preparation
Observation stays disabled and fails closed until its compatibility probe passes; status shows 'not verified' instead of 'in sync'
Drift against the confirmed baseline is detected on emulator and FDE fixture pages and is never overwritten automatically; listing UNKNOWN is never treated as mismatch
The verification sweep runs in the background with zero PCMS tabs within its bounds; a provider challenge produces one HumanTask and stops automatic passes
No primary workflow requires typing durable IDs, hashes or SecretRef strings; cohorts are never created implicitly
Refresher schedules run in the background with zero PCMS tabs within budgets and never ask for pasted source
Legacy P026 operator forms are removed and every superseded P026 DOM assertion is replaced by an equivalent assertion
A restore cannot start without a preview and typed confirmation; secrets are never included
Hold release is impossible while checks fail and every failing check links to its subject
The Modules page installs, approves, updates, rolls back, removes and purges a fixture runtime module in the packaged XPI without extension reload
The unattended driver runs only as a PersonaMonkey execution artifact through the Persona Broker under a control lease; PCMS creates no userScripts or browser-execution authority
Automatic mode refuses to enable while any gate is unmet; drifted, uncertain, paused and failed targets are never dispatched; passes are bounded and run with zero PCMS tabs
Fixture end-to-end deploy and verify succeed; the capability stays disabled for real Perchance until confirmed in a final live phase
In the operator's Firefox the installed XPI keeps scheduled PCMS work running with all dashboards closed, across idle, sleep and restart
A runtime module is installed, updated, disabled and re-enabled through PCMS with no rebuild, reinstall, reload or restart
The real generator repository scans correctly and Perchance read/listing/normalization behaviour is observed live and encoded as deterministic fixtures before any resulting fix
Assisted and (if its gate passed) unattended deployments are applied and verified on real Perchance
Induced drift and an uncertain outcome are surfaced and resolved without replay; restore, hold and release work
The operator gives final human acceptance of the extended roadmap
